channel.title: Switchback Signal
channel.description: Fresh takes for trail runners and ultrarunning hopefuls.

item.title: First Impressions of the Switchback Signal
item.description: The Switchback Signal lands with a bold grip and lightweight feel, promising to handle steep climbs and rocky descents.

item.title: Using the Switchback Signal for Hill Repeats
item.description: Hill repeats are a staple for ultrarunners, and the Switchback Signal’s design can enhance your effort on steep climbs.

item.title: Hydration Packs and the Switchback Signal: Keeping Feet Dry
item.description: Proper hydration strategy can prevent foot swelling; the Signal’s breathable upper works well with modern packs.

item.title: Tackling a Snowy 100k with the Switchback Signal
item.description: Snow and ice add a new layer of challenge; the Signal’s outsole adapts surprisingly well to slippery terrain.

item.title: Managing Foot Fatigue on Long Runs with the Switchback Signal
item.description: Endurance runs test every component of a shoe; the Signal offers subtle recovery aids for tired feet.

item.title: Durability Test: How the Switchback Signal Holds Up Over 500km
item.description: After logging 500km on mixed terrain, the Signal shows where its strengths and wear points lie.
